rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a good job identifying the primary root cause - HotReload test files being compiled for net472 without conditional exclusion. It correctly identified the multi-targeting issue and proposed the right fix pattern. However, it missed the nuance of separating cascade errors from primary errors explicitly, and completely missed identifying the separate net10.0 errors as a distinct problem. The investigation was methodical but somewhat inefficient with 42 tool calls and some failed attempts to read temp files.
